title: Figure 2: Example of Marx Generator Circuit – schematic
description: Electrical schematic of a multi-stage Marx generator showing a row of capacitors, inductors labeled L1 to L9 (50nH), and resistors R1 to R19 (1k), with a source labeled "30kV V1" at left. The caption reads "Figure 2. Example of Marx Generator Circuit." The rest of the page is text on transformer-based and explosively driven generators for HPM sources.
